senses.definition: (Cockney rhyming slang) Alternative letter-case form of Scooby.

quotes.text:
'What about reactivating these collectors' guns of yours: know anyone who'd be able to do that?'
'Not a scooby, m'lud.
quotes.reference: 2003, Ian Rankin, A Question of Blood:

quotes.text: It's all sound and fury, signifying naught; but you've got a scooby that there's more to this than reaches the eye.
I wish I knew how to talk to girls. I haven't got a scooby what to say to her, but I know I want to talk to her.
